jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. Conceptual design and future development of the secondary spectrometer, including the neutron detectors. Demonstration of its performance for the intended scientific applications.Project lead for the technical realisation of the upgrade work packages at TOFTOFExperimental tests of instrument critical components to validate performanceMethod development in the area of neutron spectroscopyOperation of the instrument and scientific and technical support in user operationPursuit of own scientific projects using neutron spectroscopy methodsYour responsibility is focused on the instrument TOFTOF. In future, your tasks might include further instrumentation projects.PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related field.Strong background in neutron spectroscopy and hands-on experience with experimental techniques and instrumentation. The Undagrid platform combines self-powered and battery-driven sensor devices with BLE-based indoor positioning, GPS/GNSS outdoor tracking and cellular IoT connectivity, and turns the resulting data into dashboards, analytics and reports that customers rely on every day. We are the leader in sensing and control products for IoT infrastructures and combine it with energy harvesting technologies for maintenance-free solutions that gain their energy from the environment enabling a sustainable world.The Role & YouYou are the technical face of our asset tracking platform towards our worldwide customer base. As an integral part of a global Customer Success team, you combine hands-on platform expertise with a strong feel for our customers’ business processes, and you turn what you learn in the field into better products.This position can be based in either Munich (Germany) , Copenhagen (Denmark) or Utrecht (the Netherlands) . customer requirements• Deliver technical and operational training for customer teams, from end users to administrators and IT stakeholders• Travel to customer sites when needed to support deployments, requirements and translate them into actionable improvements and product feedback, working closely with our sales, product marketing, product management and engineering teamsWhat we’re looking for•
